notes:
I wasn't able to research Isaiah 21, so I have no notes to give you yet.

My first attempt to open the source pages hit the tool's usage limit before any page loaded. That included Enduring Word, Ellicott, Gill and the Pulpit Commentary on biblehub.com, the NET Bible notes and Precept Austin. When I tried again with a single page, the tool told me I had no calls left for this turn. So I haven't read any page on Isaiah 21.

Your rules say I may only report what I actually read and must not fill gaps from my own knowledge. So I'm not going to write verse-by-verse notes from memory, because any such notes wouldn't come from the sources and wouldn't have real URLs.

**Next steps:** Send the request again, or just say "continue", and I'll start over. To avoid hitting the limit again, I'll open pages one or two at a time, in this order:
1. **Traditional verse-by-verse:** enduringword.com, then Ellicott, Gill, the Pulpit Commentary and Barnes on biblehub.com, then preceptaustin.org.
2. **Where Protestant traditions differ:** Calvin on ccel.org or biblehub.com for Reformed, Wesley's notes on wesley.nnu.edu for Methodist, and searches on lcms.org, spurgeon.org and similar sites. These cover the likely debated points, such as the "watchman" in verses 11–12 and whether verse 9 points to Revelation 14:8 and 18:2.
3. **Other views:** the NET Bible notes on netbible.org, bibleodyssey.org, and newadvent.org for older Catholic material.

If you'd like a smaller first pass, for example only Enduring Word plus the NET notes, tell me and I'll start there.
